reading: The sketch is a full spreadsheet UI (like Google Sheets) laid over the wireframe: a top title bar with a logo, title, menu and Share pill; a toolbar strip of editing icons; a formula bar with cell reference and formula; a column-letter header row; a row-number column down the left; a large data grid of regional sales figures; and a bottom sheet-tabs bar. All content and structure for each row is given explicitly in the typed notes, which take priority over the ink.
